### Independent Code Review — Verdict: **Pass (No material issues found)**

#### 1. Route & Canonical URL Alignment
- **Sitemap (`public/sitemap.xml`)**: Adds `/prompts/round-1`, `/prompts/round-2`, and `/prompts/round-3`. All 8 sitemap URLs use clean paths with no trailing slash, matching `trailingSlash: 'never'` in `astro.config` and the static rewrite rules (`/prompts/round-1 /prompts/round-1.html 200`, etc.). Post-submission `/thanks` remains appropriately excluded from the sitemap.
- **Canonical path normalisation (`src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro`)**:
  - Previously, `.endsWith('.html')` rewrote file-format build paths to trailing-slash URLs (`${pathname.slice(0, -5)}/`), conflicting with `trailingSlash: 'never'`.
  - The updated chain (`.replace(/\/index\.html$/, '/').replace(/\.html$/, '').replace(/\/$/, '') || '/'`) resolves `/` and `/index.html` to `https://shipagame.weevolve.app/`, and all subpages (`/feedback.html`, `/games/brinkball.html`, `/prompts/round-1.html`, and their slash/non-slash variants) to their exact trailing-slash-free canonical URLs.

#### 2. Structured Data (`JSON-LD`) & Identifier Consistency
- **Publisher ID**: Uses the required stable identifier `https://weevolve.app/#publisher` across the `Organization`, `WebSite`, `WebPage`/`CollectionPage`, and `Article` nodes.
- **Graph cross-references**:
  - `BaseLayout.astro` defines `WebPage` with `@id: ${canonical}#webpage`.
  - `src/pages/games/[...slug].astro` computes `reportUrl = new URL(\`/games/\${game.id}\`, Astro.site).href`, matching `canonical` on game pages, so `mainEntityOfPage: { '@id': \`\${reportUrl}#webpage\` }` and `WebPage.mainEntity: { '@id': reportId }` resolve to identical `@id` values.
  - `Article` (`#report`) and `VideoGame` (`#game`) link cleanly via `mainEntity` / `about` and `subjectOf`.
  - `src/pages/index.astro` sets `pageType="CollectionPage"` with an `ItemList` whose `ListItem` URLs match the canonical `/games/${game.id}` routes.
- **Fact truthfulness & constraint compliance**:
  - Frontmatter release `date` is not misrepresented as `Article.datePublished` or `dateModified`.
  - No unrecorded human or model `author` is invented; AI models (`d.model`, `d.round2Model`) are listed under `Article.about` as `SoftwareApplication` entities.
  - Benchmark intervention scores are not misrepresented as consumer `aggregateRating` or `reviewRating`.
  - `VideoGame` platform claims (`operatingSystem: 'iOS'`, `gamePlatform: 'iOS'`), App Store URLs, cover image, and screenshots come directly from existing frontmatter data.
- **XSS / Tag-closing safety**: `JSON.stringify(data).replace(/</g, '\\u003c')` safely escapes `<` before rendering via `set:html`.
